criteria.name: Core Functionality
criteria.description: Implements add, remove, display, save, and load tasks. Program should maintain a list of tasks and provide user interaction.

criteria.name: File Persistence
criteria.description: Correctly saves tasks to file and loads them back. Should handle missing files gracefully and maintain data between runs.

criteria.name: Error Handling
criteria.description: Validates user input, handles file I/O errors, prevents empty tasks, checks array bounds for task removal.

criteria.name: Code Quality and Structure
criteria.description: Well-organized code with functions or classes, clear documentation, good variable names, and user-friendly interface.
